_megjegyzes: A valódi adatbekérő xlsx 2. sorának cellakommentjei, mezőkulcs szerint — GÉPPEL kiolvasva a fixtures/adatbekero-minta.xlsx-ből, nem kézzel írva. A test/xlsx.test.js ehhez méri a generált fájlt: ha a séma útmutatói elcsúsznak vagy kimaradnak, a teszt bukik. Kivétel a három átnevezett és a hat formanyomtatvány-mező (pp_issuance_place, stairway, topographical_number, other_accommodation, occupation_before_arrival, transport_type) (place_of_birth_country, professional_qualification, previous_country): ezek szövege a sémából származik, mert a minta-xlsx még a régi, _hun végű kulcsokat tartalmazza.
personnel_reg_number:
Personnel registration number used by the employer, if one has already been assigned.
Leave empty if it is not known yet.
surname:
Current family name, spelled exactly as in the passport.
Use the Latin spelling of the passport's data page.
forename:
Current given name(s), spelled exactly as in the passport.
Enter all given names, in the passport's order.
citizenship:
Country of citizenship, written in HUNGARIAN.
Example: Szerbia, Ukrajna, Fulop-szigetek
In case of dual citizenship, enter the one in the passport used for this application.
sex:
Choose from the drop-down list:
male / female
surname_at_birth:
Family name at birth, if it differs from the current one (e.g. before marriage).
If it is the same, repeat the current family name.
forename_at_birth:
Given name at birth, if it differs from the current one.
If it is the same, repeat the current given name.
mothers_surname_at_birth: The mother's family name at birth (maiden name), not her married name.
mothers_forename_at_birth: The mother's given name at birth.
place_of_birth_country:
Country of birth. English is fine – the Hungarian form comes from the dictionary.
Example: Serbia, Ukraine
Use the country's current name.
place_of_birth_locality: Town or city of birth, exactly as in the passport.
marital_status:
Choose from the drop-down list:
married / unmarried / widow / divorced
pp_number: Passport number exactly as printed, without spaces.
pp_issuance_date:
The date the passport was issued.
Format: YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2021-06-30)
pp_validity:
The date the passport expires.
Format: YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2031-06-29)
passport_type:
Choose from the drop-down list:
private / official
number_of_rp:
Number of the current Hungarian residence permit, if the employee already has one.
Leave empty if there is none yet.
expiration_of_rp:
Expiry date of the current residence permit.
Format: YYYY-MM-DD
Leave empty if there is no permit yet.
tax_number:
Hungarian tax identification number (adoazonosito jel), 10 digits.
Leave empty if it has not been issued yet.
TAJ:
Hungarian social security number (TAJ), 9 digits.
Leave empty if it has not been issued yet.
email: An e-mail address the employee can actually be reached at. One address only.
telephone:
Phone number in international format.
Example: +36301234567
postal_code:
Postal code of the Hungarian address, 4 digits.
Example: 1052
locality:
Town or city of the Hungarian address, without the district.
Example: Budapest
name_of_public_place:
The name of the street or square ONLY, without its type.
Example: for 'Kossuth Lajos utca' enter: Kossuth Lajos
type_of_public_place:
The type of the public place ONLY, in Hungarian.
Example: utca, ter, ut, korut, sor
building:
Building marking, if any.
Example: A
Leave empty if not applicable.
floor:
Floor, if any.
Example: 3  or  fszt.
Leave empty if not applicable.
door:
Door number, if any.
Example: 14
Leave empty if not applicable.
position:
Job title, written in HUNGARIAN, exactly as in the employment contract.
Example: gepkezelo, minosegellenor
feor:
The 4-digit Hungarian FEOR occupation code, if known.
Example: 8121
employment_start:
Planned first day of work.
Format: YYYY-MM-DD
employment_end:
Planned last day of work.
Format: YYYY-MM-DD
Leave empty for an open-ended contract.
gross_salary:
Gross monthly salary in HUF, digits only, without currency sign or spaces.
Example: 450000
residence_purpose:
The purpose of the stay in Hungary.
For a work-related application: employment
educational_attainment:
Choose from the drop-down list:
primary / secondary / tertiary / none
professional_qualification:
Profession or qualification as in the diploma or certificate. English is fine – the Hungarian form comes from the dictionary.
Example: welder, electrician
Leave empty if there is none.
mother_tongue:
The employee's native language.
Example: Serbian
speaks_hungarian:
Choose from the drop-down list:
yes / no
previous_country:
Country of the last address abroad. English is fine – the Hungarian form comes from the dictionary.
Example: Serbia
previous_town: Town or city of the last address abroad.
previous_street: Street name and house number of the last address abroad, in this one cell.
pp_issuance_place:
The authority or place that issued the passport, as printed in it.
Example: Beograd, MUP Subotica
stairway:
Stairway marking, if any.
Example: II
Leave empty if not applicable.
topographical_number:
Parcel identification / land register reference number of the accommodation, if known.
Example: 12345/6
Leave empty if it is not known.
other_accommodation:
Only if the legal title of residence is none of owner / (sub)tenant / family member / courtesy user.
Describe it in one short phrase.
Leave empty otherwise.
occupation_before_arrival:
What the employee did for a living before coming to Hungary. English is fine – the Hungarian form comes from the dictionary.
Example: welder, student, unemployed
hr_emergency_contact_name: Who should we call if something happens to you at work?
hr_emergency_contact_phone: Phone number of the person above, in international format.
hr_dual_citizenship: If you hold a second citizenship, name that country.
hr_bank_account: The account your salary should be paid to, and the name of the bank.
hr_education_completion_date: When you finished your highest education.
hr_education_institution: Name of the school or university, and the faculty.
hr_degree_document_number: The serial number printed on your diploma or certificate.
hr_computer_skills: Software you can use, in one cell, separated by commas.
hr_language_skills: All your languages in THIS ONE CELL. For each: language, level, type of exam.
hr_children: All your children in THIS ONE CELL: name and date of birth for each.
hr_previous_employer: Name of the company you worked for before this job.
hr_previous_employment_end: The last day of your previous employment.
transport_type:
How the employee will travel home when the stay expires. English is fine – the Hungarian form comes from the dictionary.
Example: by car, by bus, by plane
